_comment: Doc 12 AC-03 / T-04 / T-09 — golden SLA timelines, THE SHARED CONTRACT with Doc 15 (the Doc 06 AC-09 pattern): reporting must reproduce these numbers from the same instants or the 'two numbers' argument returns (R-02). Expected values are HAND-COMPUTED (weekday/offset arithmetic verified independently of the library, S12 step 1); the library is verified AGAINST them, never the reverse. Synthetic per CLAUDE.md §8. Instants are UTC ISO-8601; durations in seconds; calendars are the T-05 snapshot contract shape (the exact jsonb an armed instance embeds).

timelines.name: us02-first-response-overnight
timelines._why: Doc 12 §8's example-sentence arithmetic (AC-04 reuses this): created Tue 17:00 Addis (hours closed), 40-min business-hours target -> first response due Wed 08:40 local = 05:40 UTC; warning at 80% = 08:32 local.

timelines.name: split-shift-monday
timelines._why: FR-12 split shifts (AC-04): active spans a Monday 07:00-19:00 UTC over an 08-12 + 14-18 split; lunch never counts.

timelines.name: recurring-holiday-enkutatash
timelines._why: FR-12 recurring holidays (AC-04): holiday stored for 2025-09-11 recurring must remove Fri 2026-09-11 too. Thu full day counts (9h), Fri holiday 0, Sat undrawn 0.

timelines.name: pause-union-ec04
timelines._why: EC-04: pending_customer [T0+1h,T0+4h] overlaps channel_unreachable [T0+2h,T0+5h]; the union [1h,5h] subtracts ONCE. Calendar-time mode (null calendar).

timelines.name: dst-window-length-berlin
timelines._why: The drawn local window keeps its drawn length across a DST switch: Sat 2026-03-28 (+01) = 07:00-16:00 UTC, Sun 2026-03-29 (+02, spring-forward) = 06:00-15:00 UTC; both 9h.
